# Federal College of Education, Abeokuta Admission Requirements 2025/2026

Federal College of Education, Abeokuta (FCE Abeokuta), Ogun State.

## General Admission Requirements

UTME Cut-off Mark: 100

**O-Level Requirements:** Five (5) credits including English Language and Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings.

**Post-UTME:** Not required (screening only).

**Aggregate Formula:** (UTME/8) + (O-Level/9)

## Schools and Departments

- School of Arts and Social Sciences
- School of Education
- School of Languages
- School of Sciences
- School of Vocational and Technical Education

## Programs Offered

- NCE in Mathematics
- NCE in English Language
- NCE in Computer Science
- NCE in Integrated Science
- NCE in Social Studies
- NCE in Agricultural Science
- NCE in Home Economics
- NCE in Business Education

## School Fees (2025/2026 Session)

- NCE Tuition: ₦45,000 per session
- Acceptance Fee: ₦10,000
- Hostel Accommodation: ₦15,000 per session

## Application Portal

Visit https://www.fce-abeokuta.edu.ng for application.
